description: GTFS (series of 3 data sets) is a series of data sets listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI). This dataset contains General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) data for the City of Abidjan, Ivory Coast. Generated by volunteers from the Digital Transport for Africa initiative (Digital Transport for Africa), this data is meant to support the transit sector and digital application development. It encompasses information on transit routes, schedules, and stop locations. Coverage: Côte d'Ivoire, Kenya, Uganda. The portal lists 3 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI). Its tags are city-of-abidjan, gtfs, ivory-coast, tumi-data. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
